The '''Endymion system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Kalamith sector/Legends|Kalamith sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endymion]].
